top_story: By 16 October, Gaza’s humanitarian collapse had deepened into catastrophic malnutrition, with crisis-level food insecurity projected to grip most of the population through the end of 2026, reinforcing how prolonged war and restrictions are reshaping daily survival rather than producing any credible stabilization. The previous day’s disclosure that Israeli spyware exploited zero-click advertising pathways and reached potentially vast numbers of devices, including those linked to Al Jazeera, extends that pattern into the digital sphere by widening the tools available for surveillance and intimidation. Taken together, these developments point to a regional environment where coercive power is expanding across physical, judicial, and technological domains while civilian vulnerability keeps intensifying.
